title: ARCH-002 closure is complete for the two named entry points (CanonicalJudgePayload::from_bytes at payload.rs:428 and CheckRequest::parse at
description: ARCH-002 closure is complete for the two named entry points (CanonicalJudgePayload::from_bytes at payload.rs:428 and CheckRequest::parse at jev/v1.rs:565 now use decode_failed, which returns INPUT_INVALID with category and line/column only and a fix hint). Two decode-side sites still use encode_failed: Question::from_json (payload.rs:245) and PayloadBundle::decode (payload.rs:520). Their code is still INPUT_INVALID, which ADR-SAG-0027 and ADR-SAG-0029(c) accept. However, encode_failed's fix hint (crates/sc-agent-types/src/error.rs:833-835) reads '… could not be encoded as JSON' for a parse failure, which is misleading. The stated rule 'encode_failed kept for encode-side sites only' is not what the tree does. Note: the Question::from_json doc block (payload.rs:229-231) says 'EncodeFailed', and the Errors section says INPUT_INVALID.
